storyChapters.title: Chapter 1: Hold Onto Your Dreams
storyChapters.summary: Zack's first mission as SOLDIER 2nd Class alongside Angeal in Wutai's Fort Tamblin, ending with the summon ambush by Genesis's allies.
keyObjectives: Defeat Behemoth on the simulated Midgar train.
Inspect the Supply Pod 20 times in the Training Room/briefing area for Cursed Ring (MISSABLE).
Defeat all 16 enemy groups in Fort Tamblin Courtyard (including rotating walls & watchtowers) for Lazard's top evaluation (MISSABLE).
Defeat Vajradhara Wu & Tai and then Ifrit with Sephiroth's aid.
storyChapters.missableAlert: MISSABLE: Supply Pod Cursed Ring & Hero of the Wutai War? (16 enemy groups in Fort Tamblin Courtyard).

bosses.name: Behemoth
bosses.tactics: Stay behind its tail to avoid Double Claw Swipe and Gyro Tail; use Battle Stance Strong Attacks.

bosses.name: Vajradhara Wu & Tai
bosses.tactics: Separate them with dodges, cast Barrier, and focus one down at a time.

bosses.name: Ifrit
bosses.tactics: Weak to Ice (Blizzard). Never cast Fire. Break Hellfire's Skill Power gauge immediately.

storyChapters.title: Chapter 2: We're Not Monsters
storyChapters.summary: Zack investigates Angeal's hometown of Banora alongside Tseng, uncovering Genesis's clones and a hidden factory.
keyObjectives: Complete all Materia Room mini-requests in Shinra Building (MISSABLE trophy).
Join Genesis Red Leather, Genesis Study Group, and Angeal Fan Clubs in Sector 8 (Ch. 2–3).
Collect all 5 glowing Lifestream spots in Banora before the bombing raid (MISSABLE trophy).
Slice all 10 artillery shells outside the Banora factory (MISSABLE).
storyChapters.missableAlert: MISSABLE: Master Mako Stone Miner (Materia Room), Banora 5 Lifestream Treasures, and Fan Club triggers.

bosses.name: Guard Spider
bosses.tactics: Weak to Lightning. Circle behind it when it fires machine-gun volleys.

bosses.name: G Eraser (Ch.3) / Banora Units
bosses.tactics: Use Thunder/Assault Twister and guard melee rushes in Battle Stance.

storyChapters.title: Chapter 3: The Angels Dream of One Thing
storyChapters.summary: Zack is promoted to SOLDIER 1st Class as Genesis Copies invade the Shinra Building.
keyObjectives: Do Squat mini-game in SOLDIER Training Room as tiers unlock.
LAST CHANCE: Join all 3 Sector 8 Fan Clubs (Red Leather, Study Group, Keepers of Honor) and give supportive dialogue.
Defend Shinra Building floors and defeat G Eraser (auto-unlocks Research Dept. QMC shop!).
storyPickups: Cura / Barrier chests during Shinra defense
storyChapters.missableAlert: LAST CHANCE for Sector 8 Fan Clubs & dialogue choices before Ch. 4 locks them!

bosses.name: G Eraser
bosses.tactics: Guard his spin slash in Battle Stance and punish with Fire/Thunder or Assault Twister. Unlocks Research Dept. QMC.

storyChapters.title: Chapter 4: Where Did Everyone Go?
storyChapters.summary: Zack meets Aerith Gainsborough in the Sector 5 Church and explores the slums before returning to Midgar during an emergency.
keyObjectives: Win Sector 5 mini-games: Number Guessing, Perfume Blending (perfect drops), Materia Pick-Up, and Wallet Thief (MISSABLE trophies).
Catch all 6 Wutai Spies in Midgar for the SOLDIER in Loveless Avenue (unlocks M4-3-x & Happy Turtle).
Clear M7-2-1 ASAP for Item Fusion Tome and M6-2-1/M6-2-3 for Sector 8 & 5 Shops.
storyChapters.missableAlert: MISSABLE: Sector 5 mini-game trophies, Aerith affection bonuses, and 6 Wutai Spies.

bosses.name: Grosspanzer
bosses.tactics: Weak to Lightning. Dodging behind the tank avoids Cannon blasts; finish off Panzer Jr. adds first.

bosses.name: Guard Scorpion
bosses.tactics: Cast Barrier, hit with Thunder/Thundara, and guard Tail Laser in Battle Stance.

storyChapters.title: Chapter 5: So Good to Be Back
storyChapters.summary: Zack and Cloud infiltrate snowy Modeoheim to confront Hollander, Genesis, and Angeal.
keyObjectives: Before leaving Midgar: answer the Reporter's quiz (do NOT report him) and talk to Silver Elite & City Planning Director.
Ace the Modeoheim Sniper mini-game without missing or overheating (MISSABLE trophy).
Sneak past guards in Mako Excavation Facility and open all 5 chests undetected (MISSABLE trophy).
storyChapters.missableAlert: MISSABLE: Sniper Elite & Master Infiltrator trophies in Modeoheim; Reporter & Silver Elite NPCs in Midgar.

bosses.name: G Eliminator
bosses.tactics: Keep Barrier up, stay behind him, and interrupt his charged slash.

bosses.name: Angeal Penance
bosses.tactics: Never attack his front when Defense of Lust is raised! Circle behind for back-crit Strong Attacks & High Jump.

storyChapters.title: Chapter 6: Are You Still Protecting Your Honor?
storyChapters.summary: Zack rests at Costa del Sol before defending Junon against a massive Genesis machine assault.
keyObjectives: Defeat all invading machines during Junon Defense without letting any pass the line (MISSABLE trophy).
Talk to Cissnei in Junon after the defense to start Zack's Fan Club (MISSABLE mail sender).
Unlock Sector 7 Shop (M4-4-3) for Mog's Amulet & Brigand's Gloves and M7-2-2/M7-2-5 for 4 Accessory Slots.
storyChapters.missableAlert: MISSABLE: Junon Defense perfect clear trophy & Cissnei Zack Fan Club trigger.

bosses.name: General's Tank
bosses.tactics: Weak to Lightning. Use Thundara/Thundaga and Wall/Barrier to shrug off cannon fire.

bosses.name: Hollander
bosses.tactics: Steal/Mug if possible, dodge his AoE potions/bombs, and punish with High Jump.

storyChapters.title: Chapter 7: I Can't Stay Here Any Longer
storyChapters.summary: Zack returns to Midgar for the last time—building Flower Wagons for Aerith before departing for Nibelheim.
keyObjectives: Build ALL 3 Flower Wagons for Aerith before speaking to Tseng/departing Midgar (MISSABLE trophy).
Complete Zack Fan Club with the Shinra Receptionist.
CRITICAL: Finish ALL 16 Midgar NPC mission triggers (M1-2-x, M2-1-x, M2-2-x, M4-3-x, M6-2-x, M7-1-x) BEFORE leaving!
storyChapters.missableAlert: POINT OF NO RETURN: Leaving Midgar at the end of Chapter 7 locks out Midgar forever!

bosses.name: Cutter / Pile / Shot Machines
bosses.tactics: Clear Support Machine first or use Quake/Darkness + Wall.

storyChapters.title: Chapter 8: If This World Were Mine
storyChapters.summary: Zack, Cloud, Tifa, and Sephiroth arrive in Nibelheim, where Sephiroth discovers his origins in Shinra Manor.
keyObjectives: Complete Seven Wonders of Nibelheim #1–#6 (Water Tower = MISSABLE Phoenix DMW!; Shinra Manor Safe = Vital Slash + 4-digit peephole code).
Watch the Shinra Manor Basement cutscene and survive the burning Nibelheim encounter.
Do NOT miss Wonder #7 in Nibelheim Outskirts right after the fire!
storyChapters.missableAlert: MISSABLE: Phoenix DMW (only missable DMW!) & Seven Wonders Expert trophy.

bosses.name: Sephiroth (Reactor)
bosses.tactics: Phase 1: Guard/dodge Octaslash & Heartless Angel; Phase 2: Stay away from the edge so you aren't knocked off the bridge!

storyChapters.title: Chapter 9: We'll All Be Heroes
storyChapters.summary: Four years after Nibelheim, Zack escapes with Cloud and fights through Shinra forces to Gongaga.
keyObjectives: Complete Seven Wonders #7 in Nibelheim Outskirts for Wall Materia.
Open the hidden chest in Gongaga Outskirts for Research Dept. QMC+ Shop (MISSABLE).
Complete the Gongaga Waterfall 7-Chest mini-game (MISSABLE trophy).
storyChapters.missableAlert: MISSABLE: Research Dept. QMC+ shop chest & Waterfall Chaser 7-chest trophy.

bosses.name: Hollander (Gongaga)
bosses.tactics: Uses Genesis Copy clones & status bombs. Bring Status Ward or Ribbon + High Jump / Costly Punch.

storyChapters.title: Chapter 10: My Living Legacy
storyChapters.location: Banora Underground · Depths of Judgment · Midgar Outskirts
storyChapters.summary: The final chapter inside Banora's Lifestream cavern: solve the LOVELESS tablets, collect the 7 Goddess Materia, and defeat Genesis.
keyObjectives: Collect all 7 Goddess Materia in Banora Underground to unlock the Depths of Judgment gate.
Optional: Defeat Behemoth King in the Depths of Judgment for Goddess Key.
Before touching the final save point/Genesis trigger, finish all remaining Missions (M1-M10) or prep for New Game+.
storyPickups: 7 Goddess Materia (Light, Heaven, Ground, Star, Life, Being, Sabbath)
storyChapters.missableAlert: Point of No Return inside Lake of Oblivion—save at the final save point before triggering the ending!

bosses.name: Behemoth King
bosses.tactics: Optional Depth of Judgment boss (576k Hard HP). Drops Goddess Key. Loop Costly Punch behind it and heal through Comet/Quake.

bosses.name: Genesis Avatar
bosses.tactics: Break his sword barriers and clear summoned G Shadow adds with Quake/Darkness before bursting the Avatar.

bosses.name: Genesis (Final)
bosses.tactics: Keep Wall + Phoenix Down active, dodge Black Flurry/Apocalypse, and finish with Costly Punch or Battle Stance.

minigames.title: Seven Wonders of Nibelheim & Shinra Manor Safe Code
minigames.summary: Talk to the boy near the Nibelheim Inn to start each Wonder in order. Includes the MISSABLE Phoenix DMW (#1) and the Shinra Manor Safe (#4).
steps: Wonder 1 (Water Tower — MISSABLE DMW): Climb/examine the Nibelheim Water Tower for the Phoenix DMW Materia.
Wonder 2 (Inn Portrait): Inspect the painting of the girl on the 2nd floor of the Nibelheim Inn, leave & return until it disappears, then check the Innkeeper.
Wonder 3 (Mt. Nibel Bomb): Head onto Mt. Nibel trail and defeat the special Bomb monster (rewards Gold Shard / Safety Bit).

Wonder 4 (Shinra Manor Safe): Inspect the locked safe upstairs in Shinra Manor. Look through the 4 keyholes in the manor rooms to count: [1] Books not on shelf (East room), [2] Smiling Faces / Ghosts (West room), [3] Banora Apples + Cans (2F East), [4] Chairs (2F West). Use the Safe Code Calculator below!
Wonder 5 (Manor Basement): Examine the coffins in the underground cave/basement (rewards Vital Slash / Moogle).
Wonder 6 (Burning Nibelheim): During the fire, rescue the boy's mother inside the burning house (1-minute timer; rewards ATK Up++).
Wonder 7 (Ch. 9 Outskirts): In Chapter 9 Nibelheim Outskirts, inspect the glowing spot near the fence for Wall Materia.

minigames.title: Aerith's 3 Flower Wagons
minigames.summary: Build all 3 Flower Wagons in Sector 5 Church BEFORE leaving Midgar at the end of Chapter 7.
steps: Wagon 1 (Cute Wagon — Automatic Story): Tools (Sector 5/Church), Old Lumber (Loveless Ave), Worn Tires (Sector 8), Artisan's Specs (M1-2-x / Shinra).
Wagon 2 (Cool Shinra Wagon): Clear all 4 Squat tiers in SOLDIER Training Room for Shinra Lunch Cart Specs, Shinra Ceramic, Shinra Treads, and Shinra Solder.
Wagon 3 (Gorgeous Wagon): Craft via Mythril Tools (talk to researcher in Shinra Exhibit Room), Walnut Wood (Sector 8), Premium Tires (Sector 5), and Craftsmanship (Loveless Ave).

minigames.title: Sector 5 Perfume Blending
minigames.summary: At the Sector 5 Slums perfume stall, add the exact target drops of Mako perfume oil—zero over/under pours.
steps: Wait for the shopkeeper's prompt: 1-drop gentle pour = tap once; large pour = hold briefly, or count the exact verbal recipe (e.g. 'just right' = 5 drops).
Mixing the exact count yields '+10 Aerith Affection' and unlocks Master Blender.

minigames.title: Sector 5 Number Guessing
minigames.summary: Pay 50 Gil to play, then ask the three nearby children for hints before locking your 1-digit guess.
steps: Talk to all 3 kids around the market stall: Kid 1 reveals odd/even, Kid 2 reveals >5 or <=5, Kid 3 narrows it to 2 numbers.
Guess correctly on the first attempt for Bingo! trophy and maximum Aerith Affection.

minigames.title: Sector 5 Materia Pick-Up & Wallet Thief
minigames.summary: Clear the Materia Pick-Up speed test under 14 seconds and catch the fleeing thief near the Sector 5 gate.
steps: Materia Pick-Up: Sprint in a tight clockwise loop starting from the top-left chest to finish in ~11–13 seconds (under 14s = 'Godlike').
Wallet Thief: Chase the kid along Sector 5 Market -> Station Street -> defeat the monsters quickly to boost Aerith Affection.

minigames.title: Aerith Affection Hidden Counter
minigames.summary: Zack's hidden affection score with Aerith unlocks extra mails and the 'Good Match For Aerith' trophy.
steps: +10 pts: Perfect Perfume Blend; +10 pts: Guess Number in 1 try; +10 pts: Godlike (<14s) Materia Pick-Up.
+5 pts: Buy Aerith the white flower ribbon / accessories at market; +10 pts: Catch Wallet Thief within 15 seconds.
+5 pts each: Dialogue choices praising Aerith or promising to come back in Ch. 4 & Ch. 7.
Threshold: 60+ total points in Ch. 4 triggers the 'Good Match For Aerith' evaluation and trophy.

minigames.title: Banora 5 Lifestream Treasures & 10 Shells
minigames.summary: Collect all 5 glowing Lifestream items before entering Angeal's house, then slice all 10 artillery shells outside the factory.
steps: 5 Spots (75-second timer): [1] North road near water, [2] Orchard path east, [3] Behind factory entrance, [4] Town square well, [5] Near Angeal's house.
10 Shells: Watch the red flash/spark as each shell approaches Zack and press Attack right before impact.

minigames.title: SOLDIER Training Room Squats (4 Tiers)
minigames.summary: Beat all 4 challengers in the Shinra HQ SOLDIER Training Room.
steps: Tier 1 (Shinra Trooper): 20+ squats -> Shinra Lunch Cart Specs + Trooper Mail.
Tier 2 (SOLDIER 3rd Class): 30+ squats -> Shinra Ceramic.
Tier 3 (SOLDIER 2nd Class): 45+ squats -> Shinra Treads.
Tier 4 (SOLDIER 1st Class Captain): 60+ squats -> Shinra Solder + Captain Mail. Watch Zack's knees hit the lowest point before tapping!

minigames.title: Modeoheim Sniper & Stealth Infiltration
minigames.summary: Zero-miss Sniper Rifle run followed by 5-chest Stealth Infiltration in the Mako Excavation Facility.
steps: Sniper: Upgrade the rifle with enemy drops (Power/Barrel) from the first crate/guards; lead moving targets slightly and release zoom between shots to cool down.
Stealth (5 Chests): Crouch behind crates when guards turn away; only move when the guard's patrol icon faces opposite. Loot all 5 chests before entering the boiler door.

minigames.title: Gongaga Waterfall 7 Chests & Ch. 10 LOVELESS Puzzle
minigames.summary: Collect all 7 waterfall chests in Ch. 9 Gongaga, then gather all 7 Goddess Materia in Ch. 10 Banora Underground.
steps: Gongaga Waterfall (Ch. 9): Hug the left/right edges of the river basin while chests fall; dodge Sahagin spawns and open all 7 chests.

Depths of Judgment (Ch. 10): Inspect the 5 LOVELESS stone tablets to reveal portals, collect all 7 Goddess Materia (Light, Heaven, Ground, Star, Life, Being, Sabbath), and insert them into the altar to open the sealed cages & Behemoth King.

magicPotEncounters.title: M10-2-3: Master Tonberry — Magic Pot DMW Unlock
magicPotEncounters.priority: DO THIS FIRST (Unlocks Magic Pot DMW)
magicPotEncounters.tips: Equip Jump, Fira, Gravity, and Assault Twister before entering. Trigger random encounters until Magic Pot appears; wait for each speech bubble before performing the exact skill.

magicPotEncounters.title: M7-6-6: The Determined Recruiter — Genji Shield
magicPotEncounters.tips: Equip Gil Toss, Costly Punch, Brutal/Genji Glove (or 23%+ Buster Sword), and 4x Octaslash Materia (buy from Research Dept. QMC+!). Wait patiently in battle for Octaslash to trigger as step 4.

magicPotEncounters.title: M2-2-6: The Nightmare Begins — Early Magic Pot
magicPotEncounters.tips: Early mission Magic Pot testing basic elemental spells + Gravity.

magicPotEncounters.title: M2-5-4: New Cavern — Midgame Magic Pot
magicPotEncounters.tips: Bring high-rank Magic (Ultima, Tri-Fire, Electrocute) plus Iron Fist before farming this random spawn.

magicPotEncounters.title: M2-5-5: Another Cavern — Advanced Magic Pot
magicPotEncounters.tips: Requires late-game Ultimate Magic Materia; equip Genji Helm (0 MP) or Dualcast/Ethers.

magicPotEncounters.title: M2-5-6: The Great Beast — Endgame Magic Pot
magicPotEncounters.tips: Pairs cleanly with an Arcane/Costly Punch endgame loadout while clearing M2-5-6.

dmwMechanics.hiddenExpRule: Zack has a hidden EXP counter alongside DMW reels. Crossing the level EXP threshold enables level-ups ONLY when the DMW rolls 7-7-7. Excess EXP banks cleanly across missions (as long as you clear, not abandon!).

emotionalPhases.notes: Baseline reel speed and Modulating Phase frequency.
Boosted by story events, DMW character matches, or Limit Breaks.
Highest chance of 7-7-7 Level Up, Limit Breaks, and Summons (triggered often after Cissnei Lucky Stars!).

dmwMechanics.limitVerge: In Reunion, Limit Breaks & Summons store into a Limit Verge button instead of auto-firing. Hold a stored Limit Verge (like Octaslash or Costly Punch combos) to shatter boss Skill Power bars immediately.
dmwMechanics.curseWarning: Curse status (from Cursed Ring, Heike Soul, or enemy hits) freezes DMW reels completely—remove Heike Soul / Cursed Ring when AFK mastering Materia or farming 100% DMW in M1-1-1!

skillPowerGauge.note: Dangerous on Hard Mode; Minerva's Judgment Arrow can wipe without Auto-Raise.
Cancels the ultimate completely and opens a huge free damage window!

battleStance.effect: Reduces incoming damage dramatically while charging Strong Attack or Command Materia (+50% to +100% damage boost).
All Battle Stance attacks and Command Materia cast from Battle Stance break the 9,999 damage cap without Brutal/Genji Glove!
Attacks & skills from Battle Stance ignore and shatter enemy Barrier / MBarrier.
Every Battle Stance kill restores HP/MP/AP and maximizes Strong Attack damage multiplier.

statusEffects.name: Poison
statusEffects.effect: Drains 5% Max HP periodically over time.
statusEffects.counter: Cure with Esuna, Remedy, or Potion; prevent with Star Pendant, Pearl Necklace, Ribbon, or Status Ward + Hell-aga.

statusEffects.name: Silence
statusEffects.effect: Prevents casting Magic Materia (Curaga, Wall, Ultima). Command Materia still works.
statusEffects.counter: Cure with Esuna or Remedy; prevent with White Cape, Mystile, Pearl Necklace, or Status Ward.

statusEffects.name: Stun
statusEffects.effect: Freezes Zack completely until the duration expires or he is struck.
statusEffects.counter: Prevent with Headband, Chocobo Armlets, Ribbon, Super Ribbon, or Status Ward + Hell-aga.

statusEffects.name: Stop
statusEffects.effect: Halts all movement, actions, and DMW reels—extremely lethal on Hard Mode.
statusEffects.counter: Prevent with Sprint Shoes, Ribbon, Super Ribbon, or Status Ward + Hell-aga (e.g., Hell Blizzaga).

statusEffects.name: Instant Death
statusEffects.effect: Kills Zack immediately regardless of HP/VIT/SPR (unless Auto-Raise is active).
statusEffects.counter: Note: Standard Ribbon does NOT block Death! Use Safety Bit, Super Ribbon, Genji Shield, or Status Ward + Hell-aga.

statusEffects.name: Curse
statusEffects.effect: Stops the DMW reels completely (no Limit Breaks, no Materia level-ups, no DMW EXP level-ups).
statusEffects.counter: Inherent to Cursed Ring & Heike Soul. Cure with Remedy/Esuna or prevent with Gris-Gris Bag / Super Ribbon.

statusEffects.name: Barrier
statusEffects.effect: Halves incoming physical damage. Stacks multiplicatively with 255 VIT.
statusEffects.counter: Apply via Barrier, Wall, Moon Bracer, Protect Ring, or Genji Shield.

statusEffects.name: MBarrier
statusEffects.effect: Halves incoming magical damage. Essential for Minerva's Crimson Flare/Krysta/Ultima.
statusEffects.counter: Apply via MBarrier, Wall, Shining Bracer, Protect Ring, or Genji Shield.

statusEffects.name: Regen
statusEffects.effect: Continuously restores HP over time—powers AFK M1-1-1 DMW farming.
statusEffects.counter: Apply via Regen Materia, Faerie Ring, or Genji Armor.

statusEffects.name: Endure
statusEffects.effect: Prevents Zack from flinching or getting interrupted during animations.
statusEffects.counter: Granted by Twisted Headband or Genji Armor.

statusEffects.name: Auto-Raise (Reraise)
statusEffects.effect: Automatically revives Zack with full HP once upon KO. Dispelled by Minerva's Judgment Arrow!
statusEffects.counter: Use Phoenix Down in battle or trigger Phoenix (Rebirth Flame) DMW.

statusEffects.name: Null Physical / Null Magic
statusEffects.effect: Certain enemies (Movers, Magic Pots, Elementals) completely negate Physical or Magic hits.
statusEffects.counter: Swap to Costly Punch/Magic vs Null Physical, or physical Command Materia vs Null Magic.

statusEffects.name: Zero MP / AP Cost
statusEffects.effect: Reduces all spell MP or skill AP costs to 0.
statusEffects.counter: Granted by Genji Helm (both), Soul of Thamasa (MP), Laurel Crown (AP), or DMW Modulating Phase.

statusEffects.name: Always Critical
statusEffects.effect: Forces every physical hit/skill to deal critical 2x damage.
statusEffects.counter: Granted by Genji Glove, Sniper Eye, or attacking directly behind an enemy's back.

reunionVsPsp.reunion: 10,000,000 HP (Normal) / 20,000,000 HP (Hard) with 255 stats and Skill Power Judgment Arrow.

Skippable animations (skipping still counts toward 100% DMW!) and faster combat flow.

L1+Face Button instant shortcuts for all 6 equipped Materia + full 360° camera control.
